priority.description: Urgency — one of the four levels
priority.title: Priority

running.description: Only tasks with a timer running right now
running.title: Running

search.description: Words that must appear in the title, description or key
search.title: Search

trackable.description: Only tasks the caller may put a timer on
trackable.title: Trackable

user_id.description: Restrict to one person, across projects (from `list_users`)
user_id.title: User Id

with_cancelled.description: Count cancelled tasks in as well
with_cancelled.title: With Cancelled

worked_from.description: Only tasks worked on from this day, YYYY-MM-DD
worked_from.title: Worked From

worked_to.description: Only tasks worked on up to this day, YYYY-MM-DD
worked_to.title: Worked To

handle.description: What to type to name its people; '' takes it away
handle.title: Handle

is_active.description: False retires it — it stops being offered
is_active.title: Is Active

status.description: `done` closes it and stamps the moment; `open` reopens it
status.title: Status

ended_on.description: The day it was cancelled. It stops charging and stays in the history
ended_on.title: Ended On

is_variable.description: The provider decides the figure each time — a CDN billed on traffic. `amount` is then the last known one, and every charge waits to be confirmed
is_variable.title: Is Variable

next_charge_on.description: Move the next charge — and the arrangement's day of the month with it
next_charge_on.title: Next Charge On

payment_fee.description: What it costs to pay it, on top of the amount
payment_fee.title: Payment Fee

shares.description: A new split; must sum to 100
shares.title: Shares

amount.description: What it cost us. The billed figure follows from the share
amount.title: Amount

api_token.description: New token. Empty keeps the stored one.
api_token.title: Api Token

base_url.description: The tracker's base URL; a Linear connection's is written by its sync
base_url.title: Base Url

external_project_id.description: The target on the tracker side: an OpenProject project id, a GitLab repository, or a Linear team. Another target, or a new api_token, un-pins a Linear connection; its next sync pins it again
external_project_id.title: External Project Id

is_active.description: Whether scheduled syncs run; omit to leave as is
is_active.title: Is Active

webhook_secret.description: New webhook secret. Empty keeps the stored one.
webhook_secret.title: Webhook Secret

unpay.description: Mark it NOT paid. Use this rather than a null date.
unpay.title: Unpay

fields.description: ONLY the fields to change, named as `get_payment_account` returns them. Anything left out keeps its current value.
fields.title: Fields

label.description: New name; omit to leave it
label.title: Label

retired.description: True retires it; false brings a retired one back (announced like a new one)
retired.title: Retired

area_ids.description: REPLACES the crafts this seat may use; omit to leave them alone
area_ids.title: Area Ids

clear_curator.description: Remove the curator. Use this rather than omitting one.
clear_curator.title: Clear Curator

bill_to.description: The client's requisites as printed on the invoice; empty names the project owners
bill_to.title: Bill To

clear_payment_account.description: Bill through the default company account again. Use this rather than omitting the account.
clear_payment_account.title: Clear Payment Account

currency.description: Billing currency for this project: UAH, USD or EUR
currency.title: Currency

default_outer_price.description: What an hour on this project sells for, for people added later
default_outer_price.title: Default Outer Price

is_active.description: False archives the project — no new tasks or timers, history kept; true restores it
is_active.title: Is Active

key_prefix.description: What leads this project's task keys. Keys already handed out are NOT rewritten
key_prefix.title: Key Prefix

manager_ids.description: Who runs this project. Sending a list REPLACES it, so read the project first and send the whole roster, not just the addition
manager_ids.title: Manager Ids

payment_account_id.description: Account to be paid into, from `list_payment_accounts`
payment_account_id.title: Payment Account Id

area_ids.description: REPLACES the crafts; omit to leave them alone
area_ids.title: Area Ids

clear_epic.description: Take it out of its epic. Use this rather than omitting one.
clear_epic.title: Clear Epic

collaborator_ids.description: REPLACES who is helping; omit to leave them alone
collaborator_ids.title: Collaborator Ids

done_time.description: When it was actually finished (ISO 8601); omit to keep it in step with the status
done_time.title: Done Time

epic_id.description: Move it into this epic — from `list_epics`, same project
epic_id.title: Epic Id

priority.description: How urgent; omit to leave it alone
priority.title: Priority

area_ids.description: REPLACES the default crafts. Seats they already hold keep theirs
area_ids.title: Area Ids

must_change_password.description: Hold their next sign-in until they set a new password
must_change_password.title: Must Change Password

must_setup_2fa.description: Hold their next sign-in until an authenticator is enrolled
must_setup_2fa.title: Must Setup 2Fa

roles.description: REPLACES every role they hold; never empty
roles.title: Roles

username.description: Their login name. Blank is refused, not "leave it"
username.title: Username
